## 1. ภาพรวมระบบ

### 1.1 ระบบ Smart Drying Factory

ระบบนี้เป็นโซลูชันสำหรับโรงอบสมุนไพรและผลไม้แบบอัจฉริยะ ประกอบด้วย:

- **การแบ่งโซนการอบ** - แยกตามประเภทพืชและระยะเวลา
- **การควบคุมอุณหภูมิ/ความชื้นแบบอัตโนมัติ** - ปรับตามชนิดพืช
- **ระบบ QR Code Traceability** - ตรวจสอบย้อนกลับได้ทุกขั้นตอน
- **AI ช่วยแนะนำรอบการอบ** - ปรับปรุงคุณภาพอย่างต่อเนื่อง
- **Dashboard แบบ Real-time** - ดูสถานะทุกโซน

### 1.2 โซนการอบ (Drying Zones)

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         Smart Drying Factory                                    │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                         Zone A - สมุนไพรทั่วไป                         │   │
│  │  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐                    │   │
│  │  │  A1 - ใบมะพร้าว│  │  A2 - ใบเตย │  │  A3 - ใบหม่อน │                    │   │
│  │  │  40-45°C     │  │  45-50°C   │  │  40-45°C   │                    │   │
│  │  │  8-10 ชม.    │  │  6-8 ชม.   │  │  10-12 ชม. │                    │   │
│  │  └─────────────┘  └─────────────┘  └─────────────┘                    │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                      Zone B - สมุนไพรพิเศษ                             │   │
│  │  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐                    │   │
│  │  │  B1 - ขมิ้น   │  │  B2 - กระวาน │  │  B3 - พริก   │                    │   │
│  │  │  50-55°C     │  │  45-50°C   │  │  55-60°C   │                    │   │
│  │  │  6-8 ชม.     │  │  8-10 ชม.  │  │  8-10 ชม.  │                    │   │

│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                      Zone C - ผลไม้                                    │   │
│  │  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐                    │   │
│  │  │  C1 - กล้วย   │  │  C2 - มะม่วง │  │  C3 - สับปะรด│                    │   │
│  │  │  55-60°C     │  │  60-65°C   │  │  55-60°C   │                    │   │
│  │  │  10-12 ชม.   │  │  8-10 ชม.  │  │  12-14 ชม. │                    │   │

│                                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                      Zone D - อบแห้งเร็ว                              │   │
│  │  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐                    │   │
│  │  │  D1 - เห็ด    │  │  D2 - ปลา   │  │  D3 - เนื้อ   │                    │   │
│  │  │  60-65°C     │  │  65-70°C   │  │  70-75°C   │                    │   │
│  │  │  4-6 ชม.     │  │  6-8 ชม.   │  │  8-10 ชม.  │                    │   │
```

### 1.3 กระบวนการทำงาน

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                              Workflow                                            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                                  │
│  1. รับวัตถุดิบ                                                                   │
│     └──► บันทึกข้อมูล (ชนิด, น้ำหนัก, แหล่งที่มา)                                  │
│         └──► สร้าง QR Code วัตถุดิบ                                              │
│                                                                                  │
│  2. จัดเข้าโซนอบ                                                                 │
│     └──► เลือกโซนตามประเภท                                                      │
│     └──► ตั้งโปรแกรมอบ (อุณหภูมิ, เวลา, ความชื้น)                                │
│     └──► สร้าง QR Code Batch                                                    │
│                                                                                  │
│  3. กระบวนการอบ                                                                 │
│     └──► ตรวจสอบสภาพแวดล้อมแบบ Real-time                                        │
│     └──► ปรับอุณหภูมิ/ความชื้นอัตโนมัติ                                            │
│     └──► บันทึกข้อมูลทุก 5 นาที                                                  │
│     └──► แจ้งเตือนเมื่อผิดปกติ                                                   │
│                                                                                  │
│  4. สิ้นสุดการอบ                                                                 │
│     └──► ตรวจสอบคุณภาพ                                                          │
│     └──► บันทึกผลการอบ                                                          │
│     └──► สร้าง QR Code สินค้าสำเร็จรูป                                           │
│                                                                                  │
│  5. บรรจุภัณฑ์และจัดเก็บ                                                         │
│     └──► พิมพ์ QR Code ติดบรรจุภัณฑ์                                             │
│     └──► บันทึกตำแหน่งจัดเก็บ                                                   │
│     └──► สร้างเอกสาร Traceability                                               │
│                                                                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 2. ระบบย่อยและโซนการทำงาน

### 2.1 Zone Management

```go
// domain/entity/zone.go
package entity

import "time"

type Zone struct {
    ID          int64     `json:"id"`
    Code        string    `json:"code"` // A1, A2, B1, etc.
    Name        string    `json:"name"`
    Category    string    `json:"category"` // herb, fruit, special, rapid
    Status      string    `json:"status"` // idle, preparing, drying, cooling, completed
    Capacity    float64   `json:"capacity"` // kg
    Temperature float64   `json:"temperature"` // current °C
    Humidity    float64   `json:"humidity"` // current %
    AirFlow     float64   `json:"air_flow"` // m/s
    Pressure    float64   `json:"pressure"` // Pa
    CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

type ZoneConfig struct {
    ID              int64     `json:"id"`
    ZoneID          int64     `json:"zone_id"`
    CropType        string    `json:"crop_type"`
    TargetTemp      float64   `json:"target_temp"`
    TargetHumidity  float64   `json:"target_humidity"`
    DryingDuration  int       `json:"drying_duration"` // hours
    CoolingDuration int       `json:"cooling_duration"` // hours
    MaxTemp         float64   `json:"max_temp"`
    MinTemp         float64   `json:"min_temp"`
    MaxHumidity     float64   `json:"max_humidity"`
    MinHumidity     float64   `json:"min_humidity"`
    FanSpeed        int       `json:"fan_speed"` // 0-100
    HeaterPower     int       `json:"heater_power"` // 0-100
    CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

type ZoneStatus struct {
    ZoneID          int64     `json:"zone_id"`
    CurrentTemp     float64   `json:"current_temp"`
    CurrentHumidity float64   `json:"current_humidity"`
    CurrentAirFlow  float64   `json:"current_air_flow"`
    CurrentPressure float64   `json:"current_pressure"`
    HeaterStatus    string    `json:"heater_status"` // on, off, error
    FanStatus       string    `json:"fan_status"`
    DoorStatus      string    `json:"door_status"` // open, closed
    IsRunning       bool      `json:"is_running"`
    ElapsedTime     int       `json:"elapsed_time"` // minutes
    RemainingTime   int       `json:"remaining_time"` // minutes
    UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}
```

### 2.2 ข้อมูลพืชและโปรแกรมอบ

```go
// domain/entity/crop.go
package entity

import "time"

type Crop struct {
    ID              int64     `json:"id"`
    Code            string    `json:"code"`
    Name            string    `json:"name"`
    ScientificName  string    `json:"scientific_name"`
    Category        string    `json:"category"` // herb, fruit, vegetable, meat, mushroom
    SubCategory     string    `json:"sub_category"`
    Origin          string    `json:"origin"`
    Season          string    `json:"season"`
    ShelfLife       int       `json:"shelf_life"` // months
    StorageTemp     float64   `json:"storage_temp"`
    StorageHumidity float64   `json:"storage_humidity"`
    CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

type DryingProgram struct {
    ID              int64     `json:"id"`
    CropID          int64     `json:"crop_id"`
    ZoneID          int64     `json:"zone_id"`
    Name            string    `json:"name"`
    Phase           int       `json:"phase"` // 1-5
    TargetTemp      float64   `json:"target_temp"`
    TargetHumidity  float64   `json:"target_humidity"`
    Duration        int       `json:"duration"` // minutes
    FanSpeed        int       `json:"fan_speed"`
    HeaterPower     int       `json:"heater_power"`
    Ventilation     bool      `json:"ventilation"`
    IsDefault       bool      `json:"is_default"`
    CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

type DryingProfile struct {
    ID              int64     `json:"id"`
    CropID          int64     `json:"crop_id"`
    Name            string    `json:"name"`
    Description     string    `json:"description"`
    Phases          []DryingProgram `json:"phases"`
    TotalDuration   int       `json:"total_duration"` // minutes
    CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}
```

## 3. QR Code Traceability System

### 3.1 QR Code Structure

```go
// domain/entity/traceability.go
package entity

import "time"

type QRCode struct {
    ID              int64     `json:"id"`
    Code            string    `json:"code"`
    Type            string    `json:"type"` // raw_material, batch, product, packaging
    BatchID         int64     `json:"batch_id"`
    CropID          int64     `json:"crop_id"`
    ZoneID          int64     `json:"zone_id"`
    Data            QRData    `json:"data"`
    CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    ExpiredAt       *time.Time `json:"expired_at"`
}

type QRData struct {
    // Raw Material
    RawMaterialID   string    `json:"raw_material_id"`
    SupplierID      string    `json:"supplier_id"`
    HarvestDate     time.Time `json:"harvest_date"`
    Origin          string    `json:"origin"`
    Weight          float64   `json:"weight"`
    Quality         string    `json:"quality"` // A, B, C
    
    // Batch
    BatchNo         string    `json:"batch_no"`
    BatchDate       time.Time `json:"batch_date"`
    ZoneCode        string    `json:"zone_code"`
    
    // Drying Process
    StartTime       time.Time `json:"start_time"`
    EndTime         time.Time `json:"end_time"`
    Duration        int       `json:"duration"` // minutes
    Temperature     []TempLog `json:"temperature"`
    Humidity        []HumLog  `json:"humidity"`
    
    // Product
    ProductID       string    `json:"product_id"`
    ProductName     string    `json:"product_name"`
    NetWeight       float64   `json:"net_weight"`
    MoistureContent float64   `json:"moisture_content"`
    WaterActivity   float64   `json:"water_activity"`
    ColorScore      float64   `json:"color_score"`
    AromaScore      float64   `json:"aroma_score"`
    
    // Packaging
    PackDate        time.Time `json:"pack_date"`
    ExpiryDate      time.Time `json:"expiry_date"`
    StorageLocation string    `json:"storage_location"`
}

type TempLog struct {
    Time    time.Time `json:"time"`
    Temp    float64   `json:"temp"`
    Zone    string    `json:"zone"`
}

type HumLog struct {
    Time    time.Time `json:"time"`
    Hum     float64   `json:"hum"`
    Zone    string    `json:"zone"`
}
```

### 3.2 QR Code Generation

```go
// application/qrcode_generator.go
package application

import (
    "context"
    "crypto/sha256"
    "encoding/base64"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "time"

    "github.com/skip2/go-qrcode"
    "github.com/yourproject/internal/modules/drying/domain/entity"
    "github.com/yourproject/internal/modules/drying/domain/repository"
)

type QRCodeGenerator struct {
    qrRepo repository.QRCodeRepository
}

func NewQRCodeGenerator(qrRepo repository.QRCodeRepository) *QRCodeGenerator {
    return &QRCodeGenerator{qrRepo: qrRepo}
}

func (g *QRCodeGenerator) GenerateRawMaterialQR(ctx context.Context, rawMaterial *RawMaterial) (string, error) {
    data := entity.QRData{
        RawMaterialID: rawMaterial.ID,
        SupplierID:    rawMaterial.SupplierID,
        HarvestDate:   rawMaterial.HarvestDate,
        Origin:        rawMaterial.Origin,
        Weight:        rawMaterial.Weight,
        Quality:       rawMaterial.Quality,
    }

    return g.generateQR(ctx, "raw_material", 0, 0, data)
}

func (g *QRCodeGenerator) GenerateBatchQR(ctx context.Context, batch *Batch, cropID int64, zoneID int64) (string, error) {
    data := entity.QRData{
        BatchNo:   batch.BatchNo,
        BatchDate: batch.CreatedAt,
        ZoneCode:  batch.ZoneCode,
        Weight:    batch.Weight,
    }

    return g.generateQR(ctx, "batch", cropID, zoneID, data)
}

func (g *QRCodeGenerator) GenerateProductQR(ctx context.Context, product *Product, batch *Batch, cropID int64) (string, error) {
    // Get drying data
    dryingData, _ := g.getDryingData(ctx, batch.ID)

    data := entity.QRData{
        ProductID:       product.ID,
        ProductName:     product.Name,
        BatchNo:         batch.BatchNo,
        ZoneCode:        batch.ZoneCode,
        StartTime:       dryingData.StartTime,
        EndTime:         dryingData.EndTime,
        Duration:        dryingData.Duration,
        Temperature:     dryingData.Temperature,
        Humidity:        dryingData.Humidity,
        NetWeight:       product.NetWeight,
        MoistureContent: product.MoistureContent,
        WaterActivity:   product.WaterActivity,
        ColorScore:      product.ColorScore,
        AromaScore:      product.AromaScore,
        PackDate:        product.PackDate,
        ExpiryDate:      product.ExpiryDate,
        StorageLocation: product.StorageLocation,
    }

    return g.generateQR(ctx, "product", cropID, batch.ZoneID, data)
}

func (g *QRCodeGenerator) generateQR(ctx context.Context, qrType string, cropID int64, zoneID int64, data entity.QRData) (string, error) {
    // Create QR code entity
    qr := &entity.QRCode{
        Type:      qrType,
        CropID:    cropID,
        ZoneID:    zoneID,
        Data:      data,
        CreatedAt: time.Now(),
    }

    // Generate unique code
    jsonData, _ := json.Marshal(data)
    hash := sha256.Sum256(jsonData)
    code := base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString(hash[:8])
    qr.Code = code

    // Save to database
    if err := g.qrRepo.Create(ctx, qr); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    // Generate QR image
    url := fmt.Sprintf("https://trace.yourdomain.com/qr/%s", code)
    qrBytes, err := qrcode.Encode(url, qrcode.Medium, 256)
    if err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    // Save QR image
    if err := g.qrRepo.SaveImage(ctx, code, qrBytes); err != nil {
        return "", err
    }

    return code, nil
}

func (g *QRCodeGenerator) getDryingData(ctx context.Context, batchID int64) (*DryingData, error) {
    // Implement logic to get drying data
    return &DryingData{
        StartTime:   time.Now().Add(-3 * time.Hour),
        EndTime:     time.Now(),
        Duration:    180,
        Temperature: []entity.TempLog{
            {Time: time.Now().Add(-3 * time.Hour), Temp: 45, Zone: "A1"},
            {Time: time.Now().Add(-2 * time.Hour), Temp: 48, Zone: "A1"},
            {Time: time.Now().Add(-1 * time.Hour), Temp: 50, Zone: "A1"},
        },
        Humidity: []entity.HumLog{
            {Time: time.Now().Add(-3 * time.Hour), Hum: 65, Zone: "A1"},
            {Time: time.Now().Add(-2 * time.Hour), Hum: 55, Zone: "A1"},
            {Time: time.Now().Add(-1 * time.Hour), Hum: 45, Zone: "A1"},
        },
    }, nil
}

type DryingData struct {
    StartTime   time.Time
    EndTime     time.Time
    Duration    int
    Temperature []entity.TempLog
    Humidity    []entity.HumLog
}

type RawMaterial struct {
    ID          string
    SupplierID  string
    HarvestDate time.Time
    Origin      string
    Weight      float64
    Quality     string
}

type Batch struct {
    ID          int64
    BatchNo     string
    CreatedAt   time.Time
    ZoneCode    string
    ZoneID      int64
    Weight      float64
}

type Product struct {
    ID              string
    Name            string
    NetWeight       float64
    MoistureContent float64
    WaterActivity   float64
    ColorScore      float64
    AromaScore      float64
    PackDate        time.Time
    ExpiryDate      time.Time
    StorageLocation string
}
```

### 3.3 QR Code Scan Handler

```go
// interfaces/http/qr_handler.go
package http

import (
    "net/http"
    "encoding/json"

    "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    "github.com/yourproject/internal/modules/drying/domain/repository"
)

type QRHandler struct {
    qrRepo repository.QRCodeRepository
    batchRepo repository.BatchRepository
    productRepo repository.ProductRepository
}

func NewQRHandler(
    qrRepo repository.QRCodeRepository,
    batchRepo repository.BatchRepository,
    productRepo repository.ProductRepository,
) *QRHandler {
    return &QRHandler{
        qrRepo:     qrRepo,
        batchRepo:  batchRepo,
        productRepo: productRepo,
    }
}

func (h *QRHandler) ScanQR(c *gin.Context) {
    code := c.Param("code")
    
    // Get QR data
    qr, err := h.qrRepo.GetByCode(c.Request.Context(), code)
    if err != nil {
        c.JSON(404, gin.H{"error": "QR code not found"})
        return
    }

    // Prepare response based on type
    var response map[string]interface{}
    
    switch qr.Type {
    case "raw_material":
        response = h.getRawMaterialData(qr)
    case "batch":
        response = h.getBatchData(qr)
    case "product":
        response = h.getProductData(qr)
    case "packaging":
        response = h.getPackagingData(qr)
    }

    c.JSON(200, response)
}

func (h *QRHandler) getRawMaterialData(qr *entity.QRCode) map[string]interface{} {
    return map[string]interface{}{
        "type":          "raw_material",
        "raw_material_id": qr.Data.RawMaterialID,
        "supplier_id":   qr.Data.SupplierID,
        "harvest_date":  qr.Data.HarvestDate,
        "origin":        qr.Data.Origin,
        "weight":        qr.Data.Weight,
        "quality":       qr.Data.Quality,
        "qr_code":       qr.Code,
        "scanned_at":    time.Now(),
        "scan_count":    qr.Data.ScanCount + 1,
    }
}

func (h *QRHandler) getBatchData(qr *entity.QRCode) map[string]interface{} {
    return map[string]interface{}{
        "type":          "batch",
        "batch_no":      qr.Data.BatchNo,
        "batch_date":    qr.Data.BatchDate,
        "zone_code":     qr.Data.ZoneCode,
        "weight":        qr.Data.Weight,
        "crop":          h.getCropInfo(qr.CropID),
        "drying_status": h.getDryingStatus(qr),
        "qr_code":       qr.Code,
        "scanned_at":    time.Now(),
        "scan_count":    qr.Data.ScanCount + 1,
    }
}

func (h *QRHandler) getProductData(qr *entity.QRCode) map[string]interface{} {
    // Get product data
    product, _ := h.productRepo.GetByID(c.Request.Context(), qr.Data.ProductID)
    
    return map[string]interface{}{
        "type":              "product",
        "product_id":        qr.Data.ProductID,
        "product_name":      qr.Data.ProductName,
        "batch_no":          qr.Data.BatchNo,
        "zone_code":         qr.Data.ZoneCode,
        "net_weight":        qr.Data.NetWeight,
        "moisture_content":  qr.Data.MoistureContent,
        "water_activity":    qr.Data.WaterActivity,
        "color_score":       qr.Data.ColorScore,
        "aroma_score":       qr.Data.AromaScore,
        "pack_date":         qr.Data.PackDate,
        "expiry_date":       qr.Data.ExpiryDate,
        "storage_location":  qr.Data.StorageLocation,
        "drying_data":       h.getDryingData(qr),
        "temperature_chart": h.getTemperatureChart(qr),
        "humidity_chart":    h.getHumidityChart(qr),
        "qr_code":           qr.Code,
        "scanned_at":        time.Now(),
        "scan_count":        qr.Data.ScanCount + 1,
        "certification":     product.Certification,
    }
}

func (h *QRHandler) getDryingData(qr *entity.QRCode) map[string]interface{} {
    return map[string]interface{}{
        "start_time":    qr.Data.StartTime,
        "end_time":      qr.Data.EndTime,
        "duration":      qr.Data.Duration,
        "temperature":   qr.Data.Temperature,
        "humidity":      qr.Data.Humidity,
    }
}

func (h *QRHandler) getTemperatureChart(qr *entity.QRCode) map[string]interface{} {
    var labels []string
    var data []float64
    
    for _, t := range qr.Data.Temperature {
        labels = append(labels, t.Time.Format("15:04"))
        data = append(data, t.Temp)
    }
    
    return map[string]interface{}{
        "labels": labels,
        "data":   data,
        "unit":   "°C",
    }
}

func (h *QRHandler) getHumidityChart(qr *entity.QRCode) map[string]interface{} {
    var labels []string
    var data []float64
    
    for _, h := range qr.Data.Humidity {
        labels = append(labels, h.Time.Format("15:04"))
        data = append(data, h.Hum)
    }
    
    return map[string]interface{}{
        "labels": labels,
        "data":   data,
        "unit":   "%",
    }
}

func (h *QRHandler) getCropInfo(cropID int64) map[string]interface{} {
    // Get crop data from repository
    return map[string]interface{}{
        "id":   cropID,
        "name": "สมุนไพรตัวอย่าง",
        "type": "herb",
    }
}

func (h *QRHandler) getDryingStatus(qr *entity.QRCode) string {
    // Determine drying status
    return "completed" // in_progress, completed, error
}
```

## 4. Hardware Components

### 4.1 รายการอุปกรณ์ต่อโซน

| Component | Model | จำนวนต่อโซน | ราคา (บาท) |
|-----------|-------|-------------|------------|
| **ESP32** | ESP32-WROOM | 1 | 350 |
| **Temperature Sensor** | DS18B20 | 3 | 150 |
| **Humidity Sensor** | DHT22 | 2 | 300 |
| **Thermocouple** | K-Type + MAX6675 | 2 | 500 |
| **Humidity Controller** | PID Controller | 1 | 800 |
| **Heater** | 2000W Electric | 1 | 1,200 |
| **Fan** | 12V DC Axial | 2 | 400 |
| **Exhaust Fan** | 220V AC | 1 | 600 |
| **Air Pump** | 12V DC | 1 | 300 |
| **Pressure Sensor** | BMP280 | 1 | 200 |
| **Door Sensor** | Magnetic Reed | 1 | 100 |
| **Relay Module** | 8-Channel | 1 | 250 |
| **Power Supply** | 12V 10A | 1 | 500 |
| **LCD Display** | 20x4 I2C | 1 | 200 |
| **QR Scanner** | USB Barcode Scanner | 1 | 800 |
| **รวมต่อโซน** | | | **~6,650** |

### 4.2 ESP32 Firmware

```cpp
// drying_zone_firmware.ino
#include <WiFi.h>
#include <PubSubClient.h>
#include <DHT.h>
#include <OneWire.h>
#include <DallasTemperature.h>
#include <Wire.h>
#include <LiquidCrystal_I2C.h>
#include <Adafruit_BMP280.h>
#include <SPI.h>
#include <MAX6675.h>

// Configuration
#define ZONE_ID "A1"
#define ZONE_NAME "Zone A1 - ใบมะพร้าว"

// WiFi
const char* ssid = "YOUR_WIFI_SSID";
const char* password = "YOUR_WIFI_PASSWORD";
const char* mqtt_server = "mqtt.yourserver.com";
const char* mqtt_topic_prefix = "drying";

// Pin Definitions
#define DHT_PIN 4
#define ONE_WIRE_PIN 5
#define DOOR_SENSOR_PIN 6
#define RELAY_HEATER_PIN 26
#define RELAY_FAN1_PIN 27
#define RELAY_FAN2_PIN 14
#define RELAY_EXHAUST_PIN 12
#define RELAY_AIR_PUMP_PIN 13
#define RELAY_ALARM_PIN 25

// Sensor Objects
DHT dht(DHT_PIN, DHT22);
OneWire oneWire(ONE_WIRE_PIN);
DallasTemperature tempSensors(&oneWire);
LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x27, 20, 4);
Adafruit_BMP280 bmp;
MAX6675 thermocouple1(10, 11, 12);
MAX6675 thermocouple2(10, 13, 14);

// WiFi and MQTT
WiFiClient espClient;
PubSubClient mqttClient(espClient);

// Variables
float temp = 0.0;
float humidity = 0.0;
float temp1 = 0.0; // DS18B20
float temp2 = 0.0; // Thermocouple 1
float temp3 = 0.0; // Thermocouple 2
float pressure = 0.0;
float targetTemp = 50.0;
float targetHumidity = 40.0;
bool isRunning = false;
bool doorOpen = false;
int elapsedTime = 0;
int remainingTime = 0;

// Timing
unsigned long lastSensorRead = 0;
unsigned long lastLCDUpdate = 0;
const unsigned long sensorInterval = 5000;
const unsigned long lcdInterval = 1000;

// Function prototypes
void setup_wifi();
void reconnect_mqtt();
void read_sensors();
void control_actuators();
void update_lcd();
void publish_data();
void mqtt_callback(char* topic, byte* payload, unsigned int length);

void setup() {
    Serial.begin(115200);
    
    // Init sensors
    dht.begin();
    tempSensors.begin();
    bmp.begin(0x76);
    
    // Init pins
    pinMode(DOOR_SENSOR_PIN, INPUT_PULLUP);
    pinMode(RELAY_HEATER_PIN, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(RELAY_FAN1_PIN, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(RELAY_FAN2_PIN, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(RELAY_EXHAUST_PIN, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(RELAY_AIR_PUMP_PIN, OUTPUT);
    pinMode(RELAY_ALARM_PIN, OUTPUT);
    
    // Turn off all
    digitalWrite(RELAY_HEATER_PIN, LOW);
    digitalWrite(RELAY_FAN1_PIN, LOW);
    digitalWrite(RELAY_FAN2_PIN, LOW);
    digitalWrite(RELAY_EXHAUST_PIN, LOW);
    digitalWrite(RELAY_AIR_PUMP_PIN, LOW);
    digitalWrite(RELAY_ALARM_PIN, LOW);
    
    // Init LCD
    lcd.init();
    lcd.backlight();
    
    setup_wifi();
    mqttClient.setServer(mqtt_server, 1883);
    mqttClient.setCallback(mqtt_callback);
    
    lcd.setCursor(0, 0);
    lcd.print("Smart Drying");
    lcd.setCursor(0, 1);
    lcd.print("Zone: " ZONE_ID);
    lcd.setCursor(0, 2);
    lcd.print("Initializing...");
    
    delay(2000);
}

void setup_wifi() {
    delay(10);
    Serial.println();
    Serial.print("Connecting to ");
    Serial.println(ssid);
    
    WiFi.begin(ssid, password);
    
    while (WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED) {
        delay(500);
        Serial.print(".");
    }
    
    Serial.println();
    Serial.println("WiFi connected");
    Serial.print("IP address: ");
    Serial.println(WiFi.localIP());
}

void reconnect_mqtt() {
    while (!mqttClient.connected()) {
        Serial.print("Attempting MQTT connection...");
        String clientId = "DryingZone_" + String(ZONE_ID);
        if (mqttClient.connect(clientId.c_str())) {
            Serial.println("connected");
            // Subscribe to control topics
            String controlTopic = String(mqtt_topic_prefix) + "/" + String(ZONE_ID) + "/control";
            mqttClient.subscribe(controlTopic.c_str());
        } else {
            Serial.print("failed, rc=");
            Serial.print(mqttClient.state());
            Serial.println(" try again in 5 seconds");
            delay(5000);
        }
    }
}

void read_sensors() {
    // Read DHT22
    temp = dht.readTemperature();
    humidity = dht.readHumidity();
    
    // Read DS18B20
    tempSensors.requestTemperatures();
    temp1 = tempSensors.getTempCByIndex(0);
    
    // Read Thermocouples
    temp2 = thermocouple1.readCelsius();
    temp3 = thermocouple2.readCelsius();
    
    // Read Pressure
    pressure = bmp.readPressure() / 100.0; // hPa
    
    // Read door
    doorOpen = digitalRead(DOOR_SENSOR_PIN) == LOW;
}

void control_actuators() {
    if (!isRunning) {
        // Turn off everything
        digitalWrite(RELAY_HEATER_PIN, LOW);
        digitalWrite(RELAY_FAN1_PIN, LOW);
        digitalWrite(RELAY_FAN2_PIN, LOW);
        digitalWrite(RELAY_EXHAUST_PIN, LOW);
        digitalWrite(RELAY_AIR_PUMP_PIN, LOW);
        return;
    }
    
    // Check if door is open
    if (doorOpen) {
        digitalWrite(RELAY_ALARM_PIN, HIGH);
        // Turn off heater for safety
        digitalWrite(RELAY_HEATER_PIN, LOW);
        return;
    } else {
        digitalWrite(RELAY_ALARM_PIN, LOW);
    }
    
    // PID-like control
    // Heater control
    if (temp < targetTemp - 1.0) {
        digitalWrite(RELAY_HEATER_PIN, HIGH);
    } else if (temp > targetTemp + 0.5) {
        digitalWrite(RELAY_HEATER_PIN, LOW);
    }
    
    // Fan control (always on when running)
    digitalWrite(RELAY_FAN1_PIN, HIGH);
    digitalWrite(RELAY_FAN2_PIN, HIGH);
    
    // Exhaust fan for humidity
    if (humidity > targetHumidity + 5.0) {
        digitalWrite(RELAY_EXHAUST_PIN, HIGH);
    } else {
        digitalWrite(RELAY_EXHAUST_PIN, LOW);
    }
    
    // Air pump (intermittent)
    if (elapsedTime % 5 < 1) { // Every 5 minutes
        digitalWrite(RELAY_AIR_PUMP_PIN, HIGH);
    } else {
        digitalWrite(RELAY_AIR_PUMP_PIN, LOW);
    }
}

void update_lcd() {
    lcd.clear();
    lcd.setCursor(0, 0);
    lcd.print(ZONE_NAME);
    
    lcd.setCursor(0, 1);
    lcd.printf("T:%.1fC H:%.0f%%", temp, humidity);
    
    lcd.setCursor(0, 2);
    lcd.printf("Target: %.0fC/%.0f%%", targetTemp, targetHumidity);
    
    lcd.setCursor(0, 3);
    if (isRunning) {
        lcd.printf("Time: %02d:%02d/%02d:%02d", 
            elapsedTime / 60, elapsedTime % 60,
            remainingTime / 60, remainingTime % 60);
    } else {
        lcd.print("Status: IDLE");
    }
}

void publish_data() {
    char buffer[512];
    
    snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer),
        "{\"zone_id\":\"%s\","
        "\"zone_name\":\"%s\","
        "\"data\":{"
        "\"temperature\":%.2f,"
        "\"humidity\":%.2f,"
        "\"temp1\":%.2f,"
        "\"temp2\":%.2f,"
        "\"temp3\":%.2f,"
        "\"pressure\":%.2f,"
        "\"door_open\":%d,"
        "\"is_running\":%d,"
        "\"elapsed_time\":%d,"
        "\"remaining_time\":%d,"
        "\"target_temp\":%.2f,"
        "\"target_humidity\":%.2f"
        "},\"timestamp\":%lu}",
        ZONE_ID, ZONE_NAME,
        temp, humidity, temp1, temp2, temp3, pressure,
        doorOpen ? 1 : 0,
        isRunning ? 1 : 0,
        elapsedTime, remainingTime,
        targetTemp, targetHumidity,
        millis() / 1000
    );
    
    String publishTopic = String(mqtt_topic_prefix) + "/" + String(ZONE_ID) + "/data";
    mqttClient.publish(publishTopic.c_str(), buffer);
}

void mqtt_callback(char* topic, byte* payload, unsigned int length) {
    String message;
    for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        message += (char)payload[i];
    }
    
    // Parse control commands
    StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
    deserializeJson(doc, message);
    
    String command = doc["command"];
    
    if (command == "start") {
        isRunning = true;
        elapsedTime = 0;
        remainingTime = doc["duration"]; // minutes
        targetTemp = doc["target_temp"];
        targetHumidity = doc["target_humidity"];
        Serial.println("Drying started");
    } else if (command == "stop") {
        isRunning = false;
        Serial.println("Drying stopped");
    } else if (command == "pause") {
        isRunning = false;
        Serial.println("Drying paused");
    } else if (command == "resume") {
        isRunning = true;
        Serial.println("Drying resumed");
    } else if (command == "set_temp") {
        targetTemp = doc["value"];
        Serial.printf("Temperature set to %.1f\n", targetTemp);
    } else if (command == "set_humidity") {
        targetHumidity = doc["value"];
        Serial.printf("Humidity set to %.1f\n", targetHumidity);
    }
}

void loop() {
    if (!mqttClient.connected()) {
        reconnect_mqtt();
    }
    mqttClient.loop();
    
    unsigned long currentMillis = millis();
    
    // Read sensors every 5 seconds
    if (currentMillis - lastSensorRead >= sensorInterval) {
        lastSensorRead = currentMillis;
        read_sensors();
        control_actuators();
        publish_data();
        
        // Update elapsed time
        if (isRunning) {
            elapsedTime += sensorInterval / 1000 / 60; // minutes
            remainingTime = max(0, remainingTime - sensorInterval / 1000 / 60);
            
            // Stop if time is up
            if (remainingTime <= 0) {
                isRunning = false;
                digitalWrite(RELAY_HEATER_PIN, LOW);
                digitalWrite(RELAY_FAN1_PIN, LOW);
                digitalWrite(RELAY_FAN2_PIN, LOW);
                digitalWrite(RELAY_EXHAUST_PIN, LOW);
                digitalWrite(RELAY_AIR_PUMP_PIN, LOW);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Update LCD every second
    if (currentMillis - lastLCDUpdate >= lcdInterval) {
        lastLCDUpdate = currentMillis;
        update_lcd();
    }
}
```

## 6. Domain Layer

### 6.1 Batch Entity

```go
// domain/entity/batch.go
package entity

import "time"

type Batch struct {
    ID              int64     `json:"id"`
    BatchNo         string    `json:"batch_no"`
    ZoneID          int64     `json:"zone_id"`
    CropID          int64     `json:"crop_id"`
    ProgramID       int64     `json:"program_id"`
    RawMaterialID   string    `json:"raw_material_id"`
    StartTime       time.Time `json:"start_time"`
    EndTime         time.Time `json:"end_time"`
    Status          string    `json:"status"` // preparing, drying, cooling, completed, failed
    InputWeight     float64   `json:"input_weight"` // kg
    OutputWeight    float64   `json:"output_weight"` // kg
    MoistureContent float64   `json:"moisture_content"` // %
    WaterActivity   float64   `json:"water_activity"`
    QualityScore    float64   `json:"quality_score"` // 0-100
    Notes           string    `json:"notes"`
    QRCode          string    `json:"qr_code"`
    CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

type BatchLog struct {
    ID          int64     `json:"id"`
    BatchID     int64     `json:"batch_id"`
    ZoneID      int64     `json:"zone_id"`
    Temperature float64   `json:"temperature"`
    Humidity    float64   `json:"humidity"`
    Pressure    float64   `json:"pressure"`
    FanSpeed    int       `json:"fan_speed"`
    HeaterPower int       `json:"heater_power"`
    DoorStatus  bool      `json:"door_status"`
    Timestamp   time.Time `json:"timestamp"`
}

type BatchQuality struct {
    ID              int64     `json:"id"`
    BatchID         int64     `json:"batch_id"`
    ColorScore      float64   `json:"color_score"` // 0-100
    AromaScore      float64   `json:"aroma_score"` // 0-100
    TextureScore    float64   `json:"texture_score"` // 0-100
    MoistureContent float64   `json:"moisture_content"` // %
    WaterActivity   float64   `json:"water_activity"`
    MicrobialTest   string    `json:"microbial_test"` // passed, failed
    OverallGrade    string    `json:"overall_grade"` // A, B, C, D
    Notes           string    `json:"notes"`
    InspectedBy     string    `json:"inspected_by"`
    InspectedAt     time.Time `json:"inspected_at"`
    CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}
```

---

## 7. Application Layer

### 7.1 Start Drying Use Case

```go
// application/start_drying.go
package application

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "time"

    "github.com/yourproject/internal/modules/drying/domain/entity"
    "github.com/yourproject/internal/modules/drying/domain/repository"
)

type StartDryingUseCase struct {
    batchRepo    repository.BatchRepository
    zoneRepo     repository.ZoneRepository
    programRepo  repository.ProgramRepository
    qrRepo       repository.QRCodeRepository
    mqttClient   MQTTClient
}

func NewStartDryingUseCase(
    batchRepo repository.BatchRepository,
    zoneRepo repository.ZoneRepository,
    programRepo repository.ProgramRepository,
    qrRepo repository.QRCodeRepository,
    mqttClient MQTTClient,
) *StartDryingUseCase {
    return &StartDryingUseCase{
        batchRepo:   batchRepo,
        zoneRepo:    zoneRepo,
        programRepo: programRepo,
        qrRepo:      qrRepo,
        mqttClient:  mqttClient,
    }
}

type StartDryingRequest struct {
    ZoneID        int64   `json:"zone_id"`
    CropID        int64   `json:"crop_id"`
    ProgramID     int64   `json:"program_id"`
    RawMaterialID string  `json:"raw_material_id"`
    InputWeight   float64 `json:"input_weight"`
    Notes         string  `json:"notes"`
}

type StartDryingResponse struct {
    BatchID     int64     `json:"batch_id"`
    BatchNo     string    `json:"batch_no"`
    ZoneID      int64     `json:"zone_id"`
    Status      string    `json:"status"`
    StartTime   time.Time `json:"start_time"`
    QRCode      string    `json:"qr_code"`
    Message     string    `json:"message"`
}

func (uc *StartDryingUseCase) Execute(ctx context.Context, req StartDryingRequest) (*StartDryingResponse, error) {
    // 1. Validate zone
    zone, err := uc.zoneRepo.GetByID(ctx, req.ZoneID)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("zone not found: %w", err)
    }
    
    if zone.Status != "idle" {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("zone is not idle, current status: %s", zone.Status)
    }
    
    // 2. Get drying program
    program, err := uc.programRepo.GetByID(ctx, req.ProgramID)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("program not found: %w", err)
    }
    
    // 3. Create batch
    batchNo := generateBatchNo()
    batch := &entity.Batch{
        BatchNo:       batchNo,
        ZoneID:        req.ZoneID,
        CropID:        req.CropID,
        ProgramID:     req.ProgramID,
        RawMaterialID: req.RawMaterialID,
        StartTime:     time.Now(),
        Status:        "preparing",
        InputWeight:   req.InputWeight,
        Notes:         req.Notes,
        CreatedAt:     time.Now(),
        UpdatedAt:     time.Now(),
    }
    
    if err := uc.batchRepo.Create(ctx, batch); err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    
    // 4. Generate QR code for batch
    qrData := entity.QRData{
        BatchNo:   batchNo,
        BatchDate: time.Now(),
        ZoneCode:  zone.Code,
        Weight:    req.InputWeight,
    }
    
    qr := &entity.QRCode{
        Type:      "batch",
        CropID:    req.CropID,
        ZoneID:    req.ZoneID,
        BatchID:   batch.ID,
        Data:      qrData,
        CreatedAt: time.Now(),
    }
    
    if err := uc.qrRepo.Create(ctx, qr); err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    
    batch.QRCode = qr.Code
    uc.batchRepo.Update(ctx, batch)
    
    // 5. Send command to zone via MQTT
    command := map[string]interface{}{
        "command":      "start",
        "duration":     program.TotalDuration / 60,
        "target_temp":  getTargetTemp(program),
        "target_humidity": getTargetHumidity(program),
    }
    
    if err := uc.mqttClient.Publish(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("drying/%s/control", zone.Code), command); err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    
    // 6. Update zone status
    zone.Status = "drying"
    if err := uc.zoneRepo.Update(ctx, zone); err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    
    return &StartDryingResponse{
        BatchID:   batch.ID,
        BatchNo:   batch.BatchNo,
        ZoneID:    req.ZoneID,
        Status:    "drying",
        StartTime: batch.StartTime,
        QRCode:    qr.Code,
        Message:   "Drying started successfully",
    }, nil
}

func generateBatchNo() string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("B-%s-%04d", time.Now().Format("20060102"), rand.Intn(10000))
}

func getTargetTemp(program *entity.DryingProfile) float64 {
    if len(program.Phases) > 0 {
        return program.Phases[0].TargetTemp
    }
    return 50.0
}

func getTargetHumidity(program *entity.DryingProfile) float64 {
    if len(program.Phases) > 0 {
        return program.Phases[0].TargetHumidity
    }
    return 40.0
}

type MQTTClient interface {
    Publish(ctx context.Context, topic string, data interface{}) error
}
```

---

## 8. API Endpoints

### 8.1 Routes

```go
// interfaces/http/routes.go
package http

import (
    "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

func SetupRoutes(
    r *gin.Engine,
    zoneHandler *ZoneHandler,
    batchHandler *BatchHandler,
    qrHandler *QRHandler,
    programHandler *ProgramHandler,
) {
    api := r.Group("/api/v1/drying")
    
    // Zone routes
    zones := api.Group("/zones")
    {
        zones.GET("/", zoneHandler.GetZones)
        zones.GET("/:id", zoneHandler.GetZone)
        zones.PUT("/:id/config", zoneHandler.UpdateConfig)
        zones.GET("/:id/status", zoneHandler.GetStatus)
        zones.POST("/:id/control", zoneHandler.ControlZone)
    }
    
    // Batch routes
    batches := api.Group("/batches")
    {
        batches.POST("/", batchHandler.StartBatch)
        batches.POST("/:id/stop", batchHandler.StopBatch)
        batches.GET("/", batchHandler.GetBatches)
        batches.GET("/:id", batchHandler.GetBatch)
        batches.GET("/:id/logs", batchHandler.GetLogs)
        batches.POST("/:id/quality", batchHandler.AddQuality)
        batches.GET("/:id/quality", batchHandler.GetQuality)
    }
    
    // Program routes
    programs := api.Group("/programs")
    {
        programs.GET("/", programHandler.GetPrograms)
        programs.GET("/:id", programHandler.GetProgram)
        programs.POST("/", programHandler.CreateProgram)
        programs.PUT("/:id", programHandler.UpdateProgram)
        programs.DELETE("/:id", programHandler.DeleteProgram)
        programs.GET("/crop/:crop_id", programHandler.GetByCrop)
    }
    
    // QR Code routes
    qr := api.Group("/qr")
    {
        qr.GET("/:code", qrHandler.ScanQR)
        qr.GET("/:code/image", qrHandler.GetQRImage)
        qr.POST("/batch/:batch_id", qrHandler.GenerateBatchQR)
        qr.POST("/product/:product_id", qrHandler.GenerateProductQR)
    }
}
```

### 8.2 API Documentation

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| **Zone** | | |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/zones` | ดูรายการโซนทั้งหมด |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/zones/:id` | ดูข้อมูลโซน |
| PUT | `/api/v1/drying/zones/:id/config` | ตั้งค่าโซน |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/zones/:id/status` | ดูสถานะโซนแบบ Real-time |
| POST | `/api/v1/drying/zones/:id/control` | ควบคุมโซน (start/stop/pause) |
| **Batch** | | |
| POST | `/api/v1/drying/batches` | เริ่มการอบใหม่ |
| POST | `/api/v1/drying/batches/:id/stop` | หยุดการอบ |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/batches` | ดูประวัติการอบ |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/batches/:id` | ดูรายละเอียดการอบ |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/batches/:id/logs` | ดู Log การอบ |
| POST | `/api/v1/drying/batches/:id/quality` | บันทึกผลตรวจคุณภาพ |
| **Program** | | |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/programs` | ดูโปรแกรมอบทั้งหมด |
| POST | `/api/v1/drying/programs` | สร้างโปรแกรมอบใหม่ |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/programs/crop/:crop_id` | ดูโปรแกรมตามพืช |
| **QR Code** | | |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/qr/:code` | สแกน QR Code (แสดงข้อมูล) |
| GET | `/api/v1/drying/qr/:code/image` | ดาวน์โหลด QR Code |
| POST | `/api/v1/drying/qr/batch/:batch_id` | สร้าง QR Code สำหรับ Batch |
| POST | `/api/v1/drying/qr/product/:product_id` | สร้าง QR Code สำหรับสินค้า |

## 9. Dashboard UI

### 9.1 React Dashboard

```tsx
// src/pages/Dashboard.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
    Grid,
    Paper,
    Typography,
    Box,
    Card,
    CardContent,
    IconButton,
    Chip,
    LinearProgress,
    Button,
    Dialog,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogContent,
    DialogActions,
    TextField,
    Select,
    MenuItem,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
    Thermostat,
    Opacity,
    Speed,
    DoorFront,
    PlayArrow,
    Stop,
    Pause,
    QrCode,
    History,
    Assessment,
    Settings,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { Line } from 'react-chartjs-2';
import { useWebSocket } from '../hooks/useWebSocket';

interface Zone {
    id: number;
    code: string;
    name: string;
    category: string;
    status: string;
    temperature: number;
    humidity: number;
    airFlow: number;
    isRunning: boolean;
    elapsedTime: number;
    remainingTime: number;
}

interface Batch {
    id: number;
    batchNo: string;
    zoneId: number;
    cropId: number;
    status: string;
    startTime: string;
    qrCode: string;
}

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
    const [zones, setZones] = useState<Zone[]>([]);
    const [batches, setBatches] = useState<Batch[]>([]);
    const [selectedZone, setSelectedZone] = useState<number | null>(null);
    const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
    const [selectedProgram, setSelectedProgram] = useState<string>('');
    const [crops, setCrops] = useState<any[]>([]);
    const [programs, setPrograms] = useState<any[]>([]);

    const { lastMessage, sendMessage } = useWebSocket('/ws/drying');

    useEffect(() => {
        fetchZones();
        fetchBatches();
        fetchCrops();
        fetchPrograms();

        // Subscribe to real-time updates
        sendMessage(JSON.stringify({
            type: 'subscribe',
            channel: 'drying_updates',
        }));
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (lastMessage) {
            const data = JSON.parse(lastMessage);
            if (data.type === 'zone_update') {
                updateZone(data.payload);
            } else if (data.type === 'batch_update') {
                updateBatch(data.payload);
            } else if (data.type === 'alert') {
                showAlert(data.payload);
            }
        }
    }, [lastMessage]);

    const fetchZones = async () => {
        const response = await fetch('/api/v1/drying/zones');
        const data = await response.json();
        setZones(data);
    };

    const fetchBatches = async () => {
        const response = await fetch('/api/v1/drying/batches?status=running');
        const data = await response.json();
        setBatches(data);
    };

    const fetchCrops = async () => {
        const response = await fetch('/api/v1/drying/crops');
        const data = await response.json();
        setCrops(data);
    };

    const fetchPrograms = async () => {
        const response = await fetch('/api/v1/drying/programs');
        const data = await response.json();
        setPrograms(data);
    };

    const updateZone = (data: Zone) => {
        setZones(prev => prev.map(z => z.id === data.id ? data : z));
    };

    const updateBatch = (data: Batch) => {
        setBatches(prev => prev.map(b => b.id === data.id ? data : b));
    };

    const showAlert = (alert: any) => {
        // Show toast notification
        console.log('Alert:', alert);
    };

    const startDrying = async () => {
        if (!selectedZone || !selectedProgram) return;

        const response = await fetch('/api/v1/drying/batches', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                zone_id: selectedZone,
                program_id: selectedProgram,
                crop_id: crops[0]?.id || 1,
                input_weight: 10,
                notes: 'Auto started from dashboard',
            }),
        });

        if (response.ok) {
            const data = await response.json();
            setBatches(prev => [...prev, data]);
            setOpenDialog(false);
            fetchZones();
        }
    };

    return (
        <Box sx={{ flexGrow: 1, p: 3 }}>
            {/* Header */}
            <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={3}>
                <Typography variant="h4">
                    🏭 Smart Drying Factory
                </Typography>
                <Box>
                    <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        startIcon={<PlayArrow />}
                        onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                    >
                        เริ่มการอบ
                    </Button>
                </Box>
            </Box>

            {/* Zone Grid */}
            <Grid container spacing={3}>
                {zones.map((zone) => (
                    <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={4} key={zone.id}>
                        <ZoneCard
                            zone={zone}
                            onControl={(command) => controlZone(zone.id, command)}
                            onViewDetails={() => setSelectedZone(zone.id)}
                        />
                    </Grid>
                ))}
            </Grid>

            {/* Running Batches */}
            {batches.length > 0 && (
                <Box mt={4}>
                    <Typography variant="h5" mb={2}>
                        📦 การอบที่กำลังดำเนินการ
                    </Typography>
                    <Grid container spacing={2}>
                        {batches.map((batch) => (
                            <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={4} key={batch.id}>
                                <BatchCard batch={batch} />
                            </Grid>
                        ))}
                    </Grid>
                </Box>
            )}

            {/* Start Drying Dialog */}
            <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
                <DialogTitle>เริ่มการอบ</DialogTitle>
                <DialogContent>
                    <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                        <TextField
                            select
                            fullWidth
                            label="เลือกโซน"
                            value={selectedZone || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => setSelectedZone(Number(e.target.value))}
                            margin="normal"
                        >
                            {zones.filter(z => z.status === 'idle').map((zone) => (
                                <MenuItem key={zone.id} value={zone.id}>
                                    {zone.code} - {zone.name}
                                </MenuItem>
                            ))}
                        </TextField>

                        <TextField
                            select
                            fullWidth
                            label="เลือกโปรแกรมอบ"
                            value={selectedProgram}
                            onChange={(e) => setSelectedProgram(e.target.value)}
                            margin="normal"
                        >
                            {programs.map((program) => (
                                <MenuItem key={program.id} value={program.id}>
                                    {program.name} ({program.totalDuration} นาที)
                                </MenuItem>
                            ))}
                        </TextField>

                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            label="น้ำหนักวัตถุดิบ (kg)"
                            type="number"
                            defaultValue={10}
                            margin="normal"
                        />

                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            label="หมายเหตุ"
                            multiline
                            rows={2}
                            margin="normal"
                        />
                    </Box>
                </DialogContent>
                <DialogActions>
                    <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>ยกเลิก</Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        onClick={startDrying}
                        disabled={!selectedZone || !selectedProgram}
                    >
                        เริ่มอบ
                    </Button>
                </DialogActions>
            </Dialog>
        </Box>
    );
};

// Zone Card Component
const ZoneCard: React.FC<{
    zone: Zone;
    onControl: (command: string) => void;
    onViewDetails: () => void;
}> = ({ zone, onControl, onViewDetails }) => {
    const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
        switch (status) {
            case 'drying': return '#4CAF50';
            case 'cooling': return '#FF9800';
            case 'idle': return '#9E9E9E';
            case 'error': return '#F44336';
            default: return '#9E9E9E';
        }
    };

    return (
        <Card sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <CardContent>
                <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
                    <Typography variant="h6">
                        {zone.code} - {zone.name}
                    </Typography>
                    <Chip
                        label={zone.status}
                        size="small"
                        sx={{ bgcolor: getStatusColor(zone.status), color: 'white' }}
                    />
                </Box>

                <Grid container spacing={2} sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                    <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap={1}>
                            <Thermostat color="primary" />
                            <Typography variant="body2">
                                อุณหภูมิ: {zone.temperature.toFixed(1)}°C
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap={1}>
                            <Opacity color="info" />
                            <Typography variant="body2">
                                ความชื้น: {zone.humidity.toFixed(1)}%
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap={1}>
                            <Speed color="secondary" />
                            <Typography variant="body2">
                                แรงลม: {zone.airFlow.toFixed(1)} m/s
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid item xs={6}>
                        <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap={1}>
                            <DoorFront />
                            <Typography variant="body2">
                                {zone.isRunning ? 'กำลังทำงาน' : 'หยุด'}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>

                {zone.isRunning && (
                    <Box sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                        <Typography variant="body2" color="textSecondary">
                            เวลาที่เหลือ: {formatTime(zone.remainingTime)}
                        </Typography>
                        <LinearProgress
                            variant="determinate"
                            value={(zone.elapsedTime / (zone.elapsedTime + zone.remainingTime)) * 100}
                            sx={{ mt: 1 }}
                        />
                    </Box>
                )}

                <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" sx={{ mt: 2 }}>
                    <Box>
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            color="success"
                            onClick={() => onControl('start')}
                            disabled={zone.isRunning}
                        >
                            <PlayArrow />
                        </IconButton>
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            color="warning"
                            onClick={() => onControl('pause')}
                            disabled={!zone.isRunning}
                        >
                            <Pause />
                        </IconButton>
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            color="error"
                            onClick={() => onControl('stop')}
                            disabled={!zone.isRunning}
                        >
                            <Stop />
                        </IconButton>
                    </Box>
                    <Box>
                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={onViewDetails}>
                            <Assessment />
                        </IconButton>
                        <IconButton size="small">
                            <QrCode />
                        </IconButton>
                        <IconButton size="small">
                            <Settings />
                        </IconButton>
                    </Box>
                </Box>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
};

// Batch Card Component
const BatchCard: React.FC<{ batch: Batch }> = ({ batch }) => {
    return (
        <Card>
            <CardContent>
                <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between">
                    <Typography variant="subtitle1">
                        {batch.batchNo}
                    </Typography>
                    <Chip
                        label={batch.status}
                        size="small"
                        color={batch.status === 'drying' ? 'success' : 'default'}
                    />
                </Box>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="textSecondary">
                    โซน: {batch.zoneId}
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body2" color="textSecondary">
                    เริ่ม: {new Date(batch.startTime).toLocaleString()}
                </Typography>
                <Box display="flex" justifyContent="flex-end" mt={1}>
                    <IconButton size="small">
                        <QrCode />
                    </IconButton>
                    <IconButton size="small">
                        <History />
                    </IconButton>
                </Box>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
};

const formatTime = (minutes: number) => {
    const h = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    const m = minutes % 60;
    return `${h}h ${m}m`;
};

export default Dashboard;
```

## 10. Mobile App

### 10.1 Flutter App - QR Scanner

```dart
// lib/screens/qr_scanner_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:mobile_scanner/mobile_scanner.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'dart:convert';

class QRScannerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  _QRScannerScreenState createState() => _QRScannerScreenState();
}

class _QRScannerScreenState extends State<QRScannerScreen> {
  final MobileScannerController controller = MobileScannerController();
  bool isScanning = true;
  Map<String, dynamic>? scannedData;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text('สแกน QR Code'),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.flash_on),
            onPressed: () => controller.toggleFlash(),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.switch_camera),
            onPressed: () => controller.switchCamera(),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          MobileScanner(
            controller: controller,
            onDetect: (capture) {
              if (!isScanning) return;
              
              final List<Barcode> barcodes = capture.barcodes;
              for (final barcode in barcodes) {
                if (barcode.rawValue != null) {
                  isScanning = false;
                  _handleQRCode(barcode.rawValue!);
                  break;
                }
              }
            },
          ),
          if (scannedData != null)
            Positioned(
              bottom: 0,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              child: _buildResultCard(),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _handleQRCode(String code) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.get(
        Uri.parse('https://api.yourserver.com/api/v1/drying/qr/$code'),
      );
      
      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
        setState(() {
          scannedData = data;
        });
      } else {
        _showError('ไม่พบข้อมูล QR Code นี้');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _showError('เกิดข้อผิดพลาด: $e');
    }
  }

  Widget _buildResultCard() {
    return Container(
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
          topLeft: Radius.circular(16),
          topRight: Radius.circular(16),
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black26,
            blurRadius: 10,
            offset: Offset(0, -2),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text(
                '📦 ข้อมูลผลิตภัณฑ์',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: Icon(Icons.close),
                onPressed: () {
                  setState(() {
                    scannedData = null;
                    isScanning = true;
                  });
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
          SizedBox(height: 8),
          if (scannedData?['type'] == 'product') ...[
            _buildInfoRow('สินค้า', scannedData?['product_name']),
            _buildInfoRow('Batch', scannedData?['batch_no']),
            _buildInfoRow('โซน', scannedData?['zone_code']),
            _buildInfoRow('น้ำหนักสุทธิ', '${scannedData?['net_weight']} kg'),
            _buildInfoRow('ความชื้น', '${scannedData?['moisture_content']}%'),
            _buildInfoRow('วันผลิต', scannedData?['pack_date']),
            _buildInfoRow('วันหมดอายุ', scannedData?['expiry_date']),
            _buildInfoRow('สถานที่เก็บ', scannedData?['storage_location']),
            
            SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              '📊 ประวัติการอบ',
              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            SizedBox(height: 4),
            Container(
              height: 100,
              child: _buildChart(),
            ),
          ] else if (scannedData?['type'] == 'batch') ...[
            _buildInfoRow('Batch', scannedData?['batch_no']),
            _buildInfoRow('โซน', scannedData?['zone_code']),
            _buildInfoRow('น้ำหนัก', '${scannedData?['weight']} kg'),
            _buildInfoRow('สถานะ', scannedData?['drying_status']),
          ],
          
          SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (scannedData?['type'] == 'product')
            ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () {
                // Navigate to product detail
              },
              icon: Icon(Icons.open_in_new),
              label: Text('ดูรายละเอียดเพิ่มเติม'),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                minimumSize: Size(double.infinity, 45),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInfoRow(String label, String? value) {
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          SizedBox(
            width: 80,
            child: Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey[600]),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              value ?? '-',
              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildChart() {
    // Implement chart using fl_chart or similar
    return Center(
      child: Text('กราฟแสดงอุณหภูมิและความชื้น'),
    );
  }

  void _showError(String message) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(message),
        backgroundColor: Colors.red,
      ),
    );
    setState(() {
      isScanning = true;
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
}
```

---

## 11. การติดตั้งและใช้งาน

### 11.1 Docker Compose

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: drying
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
      POSTGRES_DB: drying
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

  influxdb:
    image: influxdb:2.7-alpine
    environment:
      INFLUXDB_INIT_MODE: setup
      INFLUXDB_INIT_USERNAME: admin
      INFLUXDB_INIT_PASSWORD: password
      INFLUXDB_INIT_ORG: drying
      INFLUXDB_INIT_BUCKET: drying_data
      INFLUXDB_INIT_RETENTION: 30d
    ports:
      - "8086:8086"
    volumes:
      - influxdb_data:/var/lib/influxdb2

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

  mosquitto:
    image: eclipse-mosquitto:2.0
    ports:
      - "1883:1883"
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - ./mosquitto/config:/mosquitto/config

  backend:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_USER: drying
      DB_PASSWORD: password
      DB_NAME: drying
      INFLUX_URL: http://influxdb:8086
      INFLUX_TOKEN: admin:password
      INFLUX_ORG: drying
      INFLUX_BUCKET: drying_data
      MQTT_BROKER: mosquitto:1883
      REDIS_HOST: redis:6379
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - influxdb
      - redis
      - mosquitto
    volumes:
      - ./uploads:/app/uploads

  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      - backend

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  influxdb_data:
```

## 12. Business Model

### 12.1 Packaging & Pricing

| Package | Price | Zones | Features |
|---------|-------|-------|----------|
| **Starter** | ฿29,900 | 2 | ควบคุมอัตโนมัติ, QR Code พื้นฐาน |
| **Professional** | ฿89,900 | 6 | Starter + AI แนะนำ, Multi-zone, Report |
| **Enterprise** | ฿299,900 | 12 | Professional + Cloud, API, Support |
| **Custom** | ตามขนาด | 12+ | Customization, On-premise, Training |

### 12.2 Revenue Model

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Revenue Model                                │

│  ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  Per Zone: ~฿6,650                                      │ │
│  │  6 Zones: ~฿40,000                                      │ │

│  ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │

│  │  Professional: ฿29,900/ปี                               │ │
│  │  Enterprise: ฿99,900/ปี                                 │ │
│  └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                              +                                  │
│  QR Code Service                                                │
│  ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  Per QR Code: ฿5-50                                     │ │

│                                                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 12.3 Target Market

| กลุ่ม | จำนวน | ราคาที่เหมาะสม |
|------|-------|---------------|
| **โรงงานอบสมุนไพร** | 500+ | 100,000-500,000 บาท |
| **ผู้ประกอบการอาหารแห้ง** | 1,000+ | 50,000-200,000 บาท |
| **สหกรณ์การเกษตร** | 2,000+ | 100,000-300,000 บาท |
| **ศูนย์เรียนรู้เกษตร** | 500+ | 30,000-100,000 บาท |
| **โรงงานผลิตยาแผนโบราณ** | 200+ | 200,000-1,000,000 บาท |

---

## สรุป

ระบบ Smart Drying Factory เป็นโซลูชันที่ครบวงจรสำหรับโรงอบสมุนไพรและผลไม้ โดยมี:

1. **Multi-Zone Architecture** - รองรับการอบหลายประเภทพร้อมกัน
2. **Smart Control** - ควบคุมอุณหภูมิ/ความชื้นอัตโนมัติ
3. **QR Code Traceability** - ตรวจสอบย้อนกลับได้ทุกขั้นตอน
4. **AI Recommendation** - แนะนำโปรแกรมอบที่เหมาะสม
5. **Real-time Dashboard** - ดูสถานะทุกโซนแบบเรียลไทม์
6. **Mobile App** - ควบคุมและสแกน QR Code จากมือถือ

เหมาะสำหรับการขายให้กับ:
- โรงงานแปรรูปสมุนไพร
- ผู้ประกอบการอาหารแห้ง
- สหกรณ์การเกษตร
- ศูนย์เรียนรู้เกษตรสมัยใหม่
